text:
Samir: Heads up — I'd like to try a small experiment for the weekly triage: timebox the meeting to 25m, introduce a 5m 'fast-fixes' slot up front, and require explicit owner assignment for every item. Keep Wed 10:00 for now. Thoughts? cc @Jia @Marta

Jia: quick q — is the 25m including pre-read? i'd prefer async pre-reads so live time is just discussion/decisions.

Marta: +1 to timebox. agree with async pre-reads. also, can we keep the prioritization rubric (P0/P1/P2) visible during the call so decisions are consistent?

Tom: small ask — i have a recurring infra sync at 10. would 9:30 work for folks? helps APAC overlap too.

Samir: good call re: pre-reads. proposal: publish notes + links 24h before. about 9:30 — i can flex, but want to check broader owners. how about i run a 30s poll? :thumbsup: = keep 10:00, :eyes: = move to 9:30

deploy-bot: Meeting updated: "Weekly Engineering Triage" — new agenda draft attached. (calendar event updated)

Jia: :eyes: on 9:30. if we move earlier, can we alternate every other week to accommodate rotating folks?

Marta: i can do alternating weeks. also volunteered to own the first "fast-fixes" slot if that helps bootstrap owners.

Samir: thanks — can you post a compact agenda? i'll update the calendar and owners doc after we land on time.

Marta: ```
Agenda (25m)
- 5m quick-fixes (rotating owner, single-ticket focus)
- 10m priority bugs (P0/P1 triage & owner assignment)
- 5m rollouts/blocks (prod/regressions)
- 5m actions & owner confirmations
Notes: pre-reads posted 24h prior; owners add expected ETA in comments.
```

Tom: i'm in for alternating 9:30. i can take week 2 owners rotation.

Samir: awesome — plan: alternate 9:30/10:00 on a weekly cadence, first week stays 10:00, Marta takes first fast-fixes, Tom takes week 2 rotation. i'll update the "triage-owners" sheet and calendar. if anyone's blocked by the time move ping me directly.

Jia: works for me. thanks for driving this Samir.

Marta: :thumbsup:

Tom: LGTM

Samir: i'll put a 1-paragraph note in #eng and add the pre-read checklist to the meeting description. cheers.
